playpause.note: Iconography is legible, but the bright neon blue border clashes horribly with the Diablo gothic theme.

prev.note: Bright neon magenta border completely breaks the thematic constraint.

next.note: Neon green border does not fit the blood-red/ember/stone aesthetic.

repeat.note: Neon green ring breaks immersion and the crop is heavily pixelated/badly framed.

queue.note: Neon green border issue, heavily blurred and cropped badly in the close-up.

vol.note: Bright neon blue ring breaks the color palette. The tarnished iron texture is decent but ruined by the accent color.

seek.note: Neon purple outline around the track breaks theme. Bone thumb is an okay idea but feels cartoonish.

shuffle.note: Neon green outline breaks theme. Toggle design feels more sci-fi/modern than grimdark gothic.

visualizer.note: Neon yellow border is out of place. Flat black screen with a generic reflection feels cheap.

album_art.note: Neon pink border breaks theme. Screen area lacks gothic/stone integration.

notes: The base stone texture and skulls look appropriate for the Diablo/Gothic theme.
Every single control is surrounded by a brightly colored neon ring (blue, magenta, green, yellow, pink, purple) that completely ruins the dark, grimdark atmosphere.
The glowing runes are present in the base texture but look disconnected from the controls themselves.
The screens look like generic glossy modern displays pasted onto stone.
improve: Remove all neon colored borders from every control and screen. Replace them with tarnished iron rims or glowing ember/blood-red runic borders.
Ensure the CSS accent colors (blood red, ember) are actually used for control highlights instead of random neon colors.
Make the screens (visualizer, album art) look more integrated, perhaps with a clouded glass or dark crystalline surface rather than a clean modern glossy finish.
Refine the bone thumb on the seek slider to look more realistic and weathered.
